title: Scan rules: from core to zap-extensions
description: The active and passive scan rules moved out of the zaproxy core: into zap-extensions in 2012, into their own add-on projects in 2019, with the script scan rules migrating to the scripts add-on in 2023.

chapters.title: Active and passive rules move to zap-extensions, 2012
chapters.text: On 2012-12-08 zaproxy has "Issue 428: Added support for extension specific I18N bundles, and move active and passive scan rules to zap-extensions", and zap-extensions has "Issue 428: Added support for extension specific I18N bundles, and moved active and passive scan rules to zap-extensions".

chapters.title: Rules relocated to their own projects, 2019-04-03
chapters.text: On 2019-04-03 zap-extensions has six relocation commits: "ascanrules: relocate to its own project", "pscanrules: relocate to its own project", "ascanrulesBeta: relocate to its own project", "pscanrulesBeta: relocate to its own project", "ascanrulesAlpha: relocate to its own project", and "pscanrulesAlpha: relocate to its own project". The ascanrules message says it moves the files to a project of its own under addOns, removes the add-on manifest (ZapAddOn.xml, which the build now generates) and adds a build file and a CHANGELOG.md.

chapters.title: Script scan rules migrate to the scripts add-on, 2023
chapters.text: On 2023-12-27 zaproxy has "Deprecate Script Scan Rules and related classes", whose message says "These will be made available as part of the scripts add-on." On 2023-12-30 zap-extensions has "scripts: Migrate scan rule functionality from core".
